newsitem.title: USA: Storage Tech, Pratt Management end dispute.
newsitem.headline: Storage Tech, Pratt Management end dispute.

text.p: Storage Technology Corp and Pratt Management Co LLC said on Tuesday they resolved their dispute and that Pratt Management has withdrawn its lawsuit against StorageTek.

In July, a contract was terminated under which Pratt Management would have purchased StorageTek's manufacturing and development facility in Longmont, Colo. Pratt later filed suit in Boulder, in an effort to recover money.
"We have re-established our relationship with StorageTek and hope to do business with the company in the future," Pratt said.
"Both parties are pleased with the settlement," said David Lacey, StorageTek executive vice president and chief financial officer, said.
Lacey also said StorageTek was on target to move operations housed in the Longmont facility to its Louisville campus by the end of January. The facility is for sale.
